mapper.select:
SELECT U.COMPANY_CODE, U.USER_ID, U.USER_NAME, U.DEPT, U.POSITION, U.ROLE_CODE, R.ROLE_NAME FROM TB_USER_MASTER U LEFT JOIN TB_ROLE_MASTER R ON U.COMPANY_CODE = R.COMPANY_CODE AND U.ROLE_CODE = R.ROLE_CODE WHERE U.COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode}
AND U.USER_NAME LIKE '%' || #{userName} || '%'
AND U.DEPT LIKE '%' || #{dept} || '%'
AND U.POSITION LIKE '%' || #{position} || '%'
ORDER BY U.USER_ID

SELECT M.COMPANY_CODE, #{roleCode} AS ROLE_CODE, M.MENU_CODE, M.MENU_NAME, M.SYSTEM_TYPE,
NVL(A.READ_YN, 'N') AS READ_YN, NVL(A.CREATE_YN, 'N') AS CREATE_YN, NVL(A.UPDATE_YN, 'N') AS UPDATE_YN, NVL(A.DELETE_YN, 'N') AS DELETE_YN
FROM TB_MENU_MASTER M LEFT JOIN TB_ROLE_MENU_AUTH A ON M.COMPANY_CODE = A.COMPANY_CODE AND M.MENU_CODE = A.MENU_CODE AND A.ROLE_CODE = #{roleCode} WHERE M.COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} AND M.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY M.SYSTEM_TYPE, M.SORT_ORDER
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_ROLE_MENU_AUTH ( COMPANY_CODE, ROLE_CODE, MENU_CODE, READ_YN, CREATE_YN, UPDATE_YN, DELETE_YN, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{companyCode}, #{roleCode}, #{menuCode}, #{readYn}, #{createYn}, #{updateYn}, #{deleteYn}, #{createdBy}, SYSDATE, #{updatedBy}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT M.COMPANY_CODE, A.ROLE_CODE, M.MENU_CODE, M.MENU_NAME, M.MENU_URL, M.SYSTEM_TYPE, A.READ_YN, A.CREATE_YN, A.UPDATE_YN, A.DELETE_YN FROM TB_ROLE_MENU_AUTH A JOIN TB_MENU_MASTER M ON A.COMPANY_CODE = M.COMPANY_CODE AND A.MENU_CODE = M.MENU_CODE WHERE A.COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} AND A.ROLE_CODE = #{roleCode} AND A.READ_YN = 'Y' AND M.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY M.SYSTEM_TYPE, M.SORT_ORDER

SELECT M.COMPANY_CODE, 'ADMIN' AS ROLE_CODE, M.MENU_CODE, M.MENU_NAME, M.MENU_URL, M.SYSTEM_TYPE, 'Y' AS READ_YN, 'Y' AS CREATE_YN, 'Y' AS UPDATE_YN, 'Y' AS DELETE_YN FROM TB_MENU_MASTER M WHERE M.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY M.SYSTEM_TYPE, M.SORT_ORDER
